images.title: New steps, new number to subtract
images.purpose: Shows that with the steps multiply by 10, add 7, multiply by 10, add the day, the answer is 100M + 70 + D, so subtracting 70 from 1295 leaves 1225: month 12, day 25.
images.composition: The same left to right flow as the date trick: the answer, an arrow, the result split into a month box and a day box.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, generous empty margins, the main object large and centred. Top centre, small: the expression 100M + 70 + D in dark text. Middle row, left to right: the number 1295 large in dark text; one right pointing grey arrow with − 70 written above it; then the number 1225 drawn as two boxes side by side touching: a left box with teal (#0072B2) outline holding the digits 12, and a right box with amber (#E69F00) outline holding the digits 25. Under the teal box the word month in teal; under the amber box the word day in amber. Exactly 2 boxes and 1 arrow; nothing else.

images.takeaway: Change the steps and you only change the number you subtract.
images.description: Shows that with the steps multiply by 10, add 7, multiply by 10, add the day, the answer is 100M + 70 + D, so subtracting 70 from 1295 leaves 1225: month 12, day 25.
images.context: Example steps: 10M, 10M + 7, 100M + 70, 100M + 70 + D; friend reports 1295, which is 25 December.

image_decisions.why: One picture shows that the month still sits before a two digit day; only the number subtracted changes.
